title: Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a multimodal model computes 17+35 from text or 91-39 from a rendered image, it produces the same answer, 52. Does it use one internal concept of number for both, or separate machinery for each path? Similarity metrics such as RSA or CKA cannot settle this question. They give the same score to identical and to rotated directions, and two representations can look alike only because both prepare the same output digits. We therefore use causal interventions. For four conditions (text or image, addition or subtraction), we learn a small subspace of Gemma4-12B-it's residual stream in which swapping coordinates swaps the model's answer. The subspaces answer three questions. First, do the conditions write numbers along the same directions? They do not. translated_title: 超越读出层：跨模态与跨运算共享的潜在数值框架
translated_abstract: 当一个多模态模型从文本计算17+35，或从渲染图像计算91-39时，它都会得出相同的答案52。它是为两条路径使用了同一个内部数字概念，还是为每条路径使用了各自独立的机制？诸如RSA或CKA之类的相似性度量无法回答这个问题：它们对完全相同的方向和旋转后的方向给出相同的分数，而且两个表示可能仅仅因为都准备了相同的输出数字才看起来相似。因此，我们采用因果干预的方法。对于四种条件（文本或图像、加法或减法），我们在Gemma4-12B-it的残差流中学习一个小子空间，在该子空间中交换坐标会导致模型答案的交换。这些子空间回答了三个问题。首先，各条件是否沿相同的方向写入数字？答案是否定的。在同一运算中，将文本子空间复用于图像任务只能恢复53.2%的因果效应。而通过单次旋转和缩放即可将一个子空间映射到另一个子空间，并显著提高恢复率（原文在此截断）。
tldr: 通过因果干预发现，多模态模型在文本与图像、加法与减法之间共享一个统一的潜在数值框架，但各条件沿不同方向编码数字，只需一次旋转和缩放即可实现子空间间的映射并恢复大部分因果效应。
en_tdlr: Using causal interventions, this paper shows that multimodal models share a single latent numerical frame across modality and operation, with numbers encoded along direction-specific subspaces that can be aligned by a single rotation and rescaling.
